frequency: mask_common 0.231-0.268 (domain-limited); all arrays are over this band

sign_conventions.power: |AF|^2 / N_el^2 (1 = ideal equal-amplitude array at its peak)
sign_conventions.sign: exp(-i omega t); delay tau -> exp(+i omega tau)
sign_conventions.hierarchy: W_(q,p) = G_q(f) U_p(f); element (q,p) at (q Msub + p) lambda0/2; exact factorized full far field, not point-source subarrays
sign_conventions.trim: trim = constant phase per channel at f0 chosen for the REQUIRED step q tau_req(Msub); trim_p4 = Phase 4 H_trim as is
sign_conventions.window: |sin - sin(theta0)| <= 1/(2 f_max Msub d_e); 40001-point sin grid, parabolic refinement (production grid finer than the 20001 lobe grid of Revision 6, same method)
sign_conventions.strongest: strongest local maximum other than the design lobe over -90..90 deg, dB re design peak; ambiguity = strongest > -10 dB

mismatch_sweep_msub4_note: ideal-delay hypothetical, arrays mismatch_* in the npz

definitions.perturb: G_q -> G_q a_q exp(i eps_q) exp(+i 2 pi (f - f_ref) dtau_q), f_ref = 0 uncalibrated, f0 calibrated
definitions.draws: independent uniform per channel (all four for phase and amplitude; delay error e_q * q * tau_PhC so channel 0 has none, 'abs' variant e_q (N_q + 6) tau_PhC)
definitions.deterministic: phase/amplitude: linear ramp +-level end to end; delay: every channel scaled by (1 + level) in relative delay
definitions.metrics: max/rms |theta_peak - 30 deg| over mask_common; gain loss (positive = loss) = -min_f 10 log10(p/p_nom); eff_loss = same at fixed input power (post hoc); strongest = max over band of the strongest other lobe (dB re peak); R_squint = max_err / max_err(fixed phase)
definitions.budget: largest half-width with P95 (or median) of max |pointing error| (incl. nominal) <= limit, linear interpolation; system-level tolerance estimate, not a fabrication specification

restrictions_list: quantitative use only inside mask_common 0.231-0.268 (post hoc Phase 2 validation edge; domain-limited)
2-D, lossless, uniform, no disorder/coupling/thermal/bends/length-dependent loss; no fabrication model (tolerances are system-level estimates)
four channels N = 8-11 of one flat-n_g D0 mode (one-period increments only); Msub = 8 with 2-period steps and fractional periods not simulated
raw PhC has constant phase-intercept errors up to ~2.7 rad; trimmed = constant phase per channel at f0 (never ideal TTD); delay slope untouched
delay quantum 0.9811 carrier cycle per period; Msub = 4 matches to -1.89 %, other Msub do not
design lobe tracked in a window of half the subarray-level grating spacing; subarray-level replica (quantization) lobes are not removed, only suppressed by the element factor
intra-subarray phase is fixed (set at f0): the subarray element factor squints and pulls the lobe by up to ~0.16 deg even with ideal inter-subarray TTD
physical mapping is by normalized scaling only; no claim that the 2-D dielectric PhC is a microwave feed network; RF-photonic use is a different (envelope-delay) regime
common minimum run time 3500 and local-quadratic/band-fit estimators inherited from Phase 4
provenance_note: see provenance field; Phase 4/5 inputs verified by sha256 in tests/test_phase6.py
